name: Outrider Standard Care Package
summary: Outrider Standard Care Package is a recognition quest offered by the Warsong Outriders to Horde warriors proving their mettle in Warsong Gulch. Offered by Kelm Hargunth in the northern Barrens, it supplies battle-tested champions with essential combat supplies tailored for skirmishes in the disputed canyon. Receiving the bundle marks a warrior's growing trust among the frontline forces.

sections.title: Supplies for the Front
sections.body: The skirmishes between the Warsong Outriders and the Silverwing Sentinels are grueling tests of attrition. Kelm Hargunth, coordinating field logistics from the edge of the Barrens, rewards those who repeatedly throw themselves into the contested gulch. The standard care package provides specialized bandages and field rations suited for the rapid pace of combat within the valley, helping champions sustain the Horde's offensive.

sections.title: Earning Outrider Trust
sections.body: Rank and logistics go hand in hand among the Warsong Outriders. Kelm notes that as a soldier's standing improves, these vital rations and field dressings transition from occasional handouts into regular quartermaster supplies. Proving oneself through service inside the gulch secures steady access to provisions necessary to counter the night elves' woodland ambushes.

faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth, an officer and supply liaison for the Warsong Outriders stationed in the northern Barrens near the Ashenvale border, distributes this package to champions proving their worth.
The package contains specialized rations and combat bandages meant to sustain a soldier during the brutal skirmishes inside Warsong Gulch.

faq.q: Where can the supplies be used?
faq.answer: The bandages and provisions supplied in the package are strictly battlefield rations intended for use within Warsong Gulch itself.

faq.q: How do you earn further supplies?
aliases: how to buy care package items
faq.answer: As you build standing with the Warsong Outriders, their quartermasters make these battlefield rations and bandages available directly for purchase, starting at Friendly and Honored reputation ranks.

faq.q: Why are the Warsong Outriders fighting here?
faq.answer: The Warsong Outriders are securing vital timber and land for the Horde, clashing head-on with the Silverwing Sentinels of Ashenvale who fiercely guard their ancient forest borders.

faq.q: What comes after this care package?
faq.answer: Continued valor and rising standing among the Warsong Outriders eventually leads to the Outrider Advanced Care Package, offering even greater quartermaster recognition.

angles.text: Warsong Gulch is a vital theater for the Horde's lumber and territorial security, and these provisions sustain loyal fighters pushing back against the Night Elves.
The Warsong Clan spearheads the operation in Ashenvale, making service to the Outriders a matter of deep clan pride and martial duty.
